name: tetri
description: Ask about your Tetri wallets, balances, transactions, budgets, goals and reports, and record, categorize, correct or delete transactions after you confirm them, from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Your Tetri finances: balances, spending, budgets
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to your Tetri workspace. Ask about balances, spending by category, budgets, goals, recurring payments and monthly reports, describe a purchase in plain words, or have uncategorized transactions sorted, and Codex makes each change after you confirm. You sign in to Tetri in the browser; the plugin stores no token.
defaultPrompt: What is my balance in each wallet?
How did my spending this month compare with last month?
Record 12.50 for lunch today, paid from my card
